items: emit only typed phase-resolved Weather/cloud state and R26 optical-input lineage; never emit renderer density, RGB or Conservative Density as canonical truth
keep cloud fraction/overlap separate from in-cloud condensate and local extinction
when Lighting reports a mismatch, change Weather only if a Weather invariant fails; do not tune Weather to compensate for renderer sampling or phase approximations
produce one immutable SpectralLayerOpticalPacket and derive a LocalPhysicalCoefficientPacket only after path/distribution semantics are explicit
enforce sigma_t=sigma_s+sigma_a and preserve source spectral/phase identities
retain source g separately from any renderer-specific multi-lobe phase binding
reject a renderer request for raw density/extinction when unit/path semantics are missing
compare renderers through physical SI coefficient invariants before comparing raw engine parameters or pixels
for Karma-style routing use documented m^-1 absorption/scattering and declared compatible anisotropy semantics
for UE-style routing derive physical albedo and physical sigma_t first; leave final engine Extinction unbound until a unit calibration/source proof exists
do not invent UE Phase A/Phase B/Blend from one source g; record an explicit PhaseFunctionBinding approximation
treat UE Conservative Density and sampling/multiscatter/shadow quality controls as evaluator-only acceleration/quality state
run homogeneous-slab Beer tests at two path lengths before visual cloud tuning
add RendererAdapterIdentity, RendererUnitBinding, PhaseFunctionBinding and RenderAccelerationHint provenance types
use LocalPhysicalCoefficientPacket as the cross-renderer validation surface rather than raw vendor parameters
preserve one-way state flow Weather -> spectral optics -> SI local coefficients -> renderer binding -> display projection
